name: Hash-ribbon capitulation with RSI-washout confirm (BTC, momentum exit)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the bb_z variant: this gauges over-extension via RSI, not the band z-score, and exits on price-momentum recovery rather than a hashrate re-cross): miner capitulation forces contraction of btc_hashrate; buying that contraction when RSI is deeply oversold takes the other side of a distressed forced-seller flow that unwinds over weeks. The dual gate (hashrate contracted AND RSI washed out) demands BOTH the supply-side exhaustion and a price washout, filtering the 'hashrate low but price still elevated' false starts. Exit is a positive medium-term return re-cross (ret_Nd back above a floor), harvesting the mean-reversion when momentum turns. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a bare RSI-oversold dip-buy on price matches the deflated Sharpe, the hashrate feature is redundant and this dies. DISCONFIRMER 2: hashrate contractions cluster in violent down-legs (halving-cycle survivorship) -> KILL if the post-2023 slice collapses or if this catches falling knives beyond the DD cap. Must clear DSR>=0.95, maxDD<=25%, net of fees.
catalyst: miner hashrate contraction confirmed by a deep RSI washout
